Sandbox_PurgeOnSpawn_tooltip: Enable this so you don't immediately die because you spawned next to a zombie hidden next to the trees
Sandbox_PurgeDistance_tooltip: This is how far the decimator will, well, decimate zombies. It only runs once when you spawn.
Sandbox_VehicleSpawnToggle_tooltip: Disable this to prevent starting vehicles and trailers from spawning, effectively disabling the mod.
Sandbox_TrailerSpawnToggle_tooltip: Disable this to prevent starting trailers from spawning.
Sandbox_TrailerSpawnChance_tooltip: Change this to adjust the chance that a trailer will spawn.
